newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Archer Daniels said cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Archer Daniels said cut.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette analyst Bill Leach downgraded Archer Daniels Midland Co to market perform from buy, according to a DLJ source.
-- reduced share earnings estimates to $1.15 per share from $1.30 for 1997, ending in June, and to $1.15 from $1.35 for 1998, the source said.
-- according to the source, Leach said the fructose business "is a mess, and has gotten even worse," and it appears ADM will lose money in (the third) quarter.
-- said the soybean business is also under some margin pressure, and "will probably stay under pressure until the new crop comes in in October," according to the source.
-- said ethanol pricing has also come down.
